method: Quiet original/POP/POP/original ABBA; fresh Chrome and normal UI import of identical MBX fixture per run. Eleven rounds each,first separate,ten warm;20 warm samples/action/arm. Original runtime and frontend byte-identical; only POP seed/admission and derived offline revision differ. Actual release timestamps, unchanged30ms pulse and50ms/500ms readiness method from055. VM diagnostic,not reference-laptop acceptance.

report.method: 50 ms canvas sampling; changed pixels exclude status bar; readiness must remain visually stable 500 ms. Ready time starts that stable interval. Legacy readyMs/firstVisibleMs start before mouse-down; release-relative fields use the actual browser pointerup event. First/warm are separate; at least20 warm samples are required for a per-action p95.
